thread:
hannah: quick follow-up from this morning's design session. i wanted to pull together 'spillback' vs 'pin-and-migrate' safety knobs we didn't finalize.

jules: good call. summary: pin-and-migrate = move tenant ownership (lease) to new shard; spillback = allow temporary remote consumption via donor-issued tokens. both have pros/cons.

omar: my gut: prefer spillback for <500ms bursts; migrate for sustained load. question: how do we avoid duplicate active slots if migration fails mid-flight?

srin: two-layer guard: 1) lease record with generation and expiry (CAS semantics). 2) migration fence: when migration starts write marker {tenant, gen+1, migrating:true}. data-plane checks marker.gen to accept/reject tokens.

hannah: yep. additionally, add hysteresis to migration decisions: require overload signal to persist for T_long before triggering migration (T_long default 30s), but allow spill tokens immediately.

jules: hysteresis helps, also define a 'cooldown window' post-migration where tenant is ineligible for another migration for M minutes. prevents ping-pong.

omar: what about observability? need metrics for spill-token-issue, spill-token-consume, migration-start, migration-complete, lease-conflict. small dashboard required before canary.

srin: security/anti-abuse: tokens must be signed and include donor_shard, tenant_id, capacity, expiry, nonce. recipients validate signature and check donor_shard ownership snapshot. tokens should be single-use nonces recorded in a small LRU to avoid replay.

hannah: LRU size should be tiny per-shard (e.g., 1024 recent nonces) to keep mem overhead low. tokens TTL 200-800ms by default.

jules: another tricky scenario: donor shard advert stale -> recipient accepts token but donor actually lacks capacity. solution: donors mint tokens only if local commit succeeds (local decremented counters) and they emit an issuance event to event-log. recipients can optionally check issuance events async for audits.

omar: that means donors do the heavy lifting synchronously (debit + sign). cheap path but safe.

srin: lease collisions: two shards try to acquire lease same time. use CAS on metadata store. loser backoffs with jitter. emit lease_conflict metric and surface top 10 tenants by conflicts.

hannah: for legal/billing hard caps we must fail-closed: no spill tokens, no migration that would increase apparent usage beyond cap. slow-path consult to central quota authority on these tenants. document them as MUST_FAIL in metadata.

jules: rollout plan: 1) implement token format + signing + small LRU replay guard. 2) enable adverts and token issuance in read-only (emit events only). 3) canary: 5% traffic with tokens accepted but no active migration. 4) enable migration with hysteresis + cooldown for 1% tenants.

omar: testing: synthetic driver for microbursts (100k bursts/sec), traffic replay, and chaos where donor shards crash after issuing tokens to ensure replay guard handles rejections gracefully.

srin: ops playbook snippets: - detect migration oscillation -> increase hysteresis and cooldown, reduce dampening. - many lease_conflicts -> throttle migration rate and investigate hot tenants. - spike in token-failures -> pause token acceptance and roll into donor-only mode.

hannah: small CLI commands for ops: `rlctl pin-tenant <tenant> --shard S` and `rlctl pause-rebalancer` and `rlctl bump-cooldown <minutes>` for quick mitigation. include RBAC on these.

jules: security: all token signing keys rotate daily; public keys published to control-plane; shards must validate mTLS + claim shard-id before minting.

omar: metrics thresholds: migration_rate_alert = 5 migrations/min per cluster; lease_conflict_alert = >10/min; token_replay_rate > 0.1% -> alert. we'll tune in canary.

srin: final note: make the token format compact (binary-friendly) but include an ASCII-safe base64 representation for logs. e.g., `token := b64(sig || tenant || cap || exp || nonce)`.

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-2267 "spillback tokens + migration hysteresis + lease guards" and linked this thread.

hannah: i'll author a short RFC addendum with formats + defaults and link the ticket. jules will prototype token signing, omar will add LRU replay guard, srin will do CAS lease spec.

jules: thanks all. aim to canary in two sprints. :rocket:
